actual_model_identity: Codex based on GPT-6; exact serving variant not independently exposed
capabilities_used: primary-source web lookup and bounded publisher HTTPS reacquisition
PDF rendering and actual view_image visual inspection of four pages
ui_acceptance: Internal development CLI/source artifact boundary; no live browser UI required or claimed. Chrome untouched.

source_identity.manifest_required_full_book_files: No full-book bytes or pinned revisions provided; copied fixture contains only SRD PDF and manifest.

criteria.criterion: Retain the unchanged official English SRD 5.2.1 PDF with successful bounded acquisition, SHA256, size, publisher/title/version/language/acquisition provenance, actual page count and verified legal/section page locators.
criteria.procedure: Hash actual pinned PDF, reacquire fixed publisher URL with 55-second/64MiB curl bounds, compare exact bytes; parse page count and all locators; render and inspect four legal/contents/index pages.
criteria.expected: Official English 5.2.1 bytes unchanged, provenance pinned, 364 actual pages and accurate legal/section locators.
criteria.observed: Independent publisher acquisition completed in 0.341 seconds, byte-identical 6031375-byte PDF with expected SHA256; publisher/title/version/language and all submitted section-start locators agree with legal page and contents.

criteria.criterion: Preserve source attribution and license evidence limited to the acquired SRD contents; explicitly record unacquired PHB/DMG/Monster Manual source revisions and unresolved rights/catalog gates, without claiming full 2024 coverage or a reviewed production RightsGrant.
criteria.procedure: Inspect actual manifest, publisher license/legal page and plans; compare scope assertions to missing full-book revisions and rights/catalog requirements.
criteria.expected: Attribution and license retained for acquired SRD only; full PHB/DMG/MM sources, revisions and production rights/catalog remain unresolved.
criteria.observed: Submitted manifest has correct complete attribution and CC-BY-4.0 evidence; all three required core books explicitly unacquired with null revisions, partial scope, unresolved denominator/non-SRD rights and no production RulesetId. No full-coverage claim.

criteria.criterion: Provide a bounded read-only development verifier for the pinned source manifest and bytes, with observed success and safe failure for corrupted bytes, malformed metadata, mixed source edition and missing required full-book sources; no game runtime schema or catalog implementation.
criteria.procedure: Execute actual committed verifier and independent owned fixtures for corrupt bytes, missing language, mixed edition, missing full-book record, genuinely unavailable full-book bytes, malformed attribution and FIFO manifest; inspect CLI and source checks.
criteria.expected: Partial-source success plus safe failures for all specified invalid cases, including actual missing required full-book sources; malformed attribution rejected and input processing bounded.
criteria.observed: Valid SRD succeeds and corrupt/language/edition cases fail. Omitting a book metadata record fails, but retaining all three records with all full-book bytes unavailable succeeds; no explicit full-source gate option exists. Empty attribution and two-word attribution both succeed. FIFO manifest blocks until external 2-second timeout; source has no regular-file/manifest-size check or internal deadline. The 2-second observation is not represented as a measured 60-second overrun.

criteria.criterion: Retain exact committed source/evidence identities, commands and results, relevant PDF visual inspection, known gaps and scoped devlog; edits remain confined to the independent source-pin area.
criteria.procedure: Record clean exact source commit, file hashes, Python AST and diff checks, independent command/results and visual observations; inspect changed-path confinement and append scoped evaluator devlog.
criteria.expected: Exact tested identities and reproducible evidence retained, known full-source gaps explicit, only independent source-pin paths changed.
criteria.observed: Clean source commit 0df797256ae35350521fa9dc0d4ece8d5b85b4a0 changes only verifier, manifest and source PDF. AST/diff pass; independent scripts, results, hashes and four inspected PNGs retained. Worker and evaluator scoped observations retained. No Rust/Cargo changes; corresponding build gates inapplicable.

defects.expected: Require complete pinned attribution, not an arbitrary matching substring.
defects.observed: Empty string and "This work" normalize to substrings of the legal page, both return exit 0/result verified.
defects.reproduce: Run committed verifier --manifest against empty-attribution or short-attribution fixtures generated by run-independent.py.

defects.expected: Expose and exercise an explicit safe refusal of full-source qualification when required core-book bytes/revisions are unavailable, while preserving honest partial SRD integrity success.
defects.observed: Only missing book metadata record is tested as a negative. Actual absent full-book sources are required to be unacquired and return verified/exit 0; no separate full-source check exists. Metadata completeness does not prove the specified missing-source failure.
defects.reproduce: Run actual-source and required-books-recorded-but-unavailable fixtures; inspect --help for absence of a qualification mode.

defects.expected: Reject nonregular manifest input promptly and bound manifest bytes/work.
defects.observed: Owned FIFO supplied as --manifest blocks at read_text; reviewer external 2-second deadline terminates it. No regular-file/manifest-byte check or intrinsic deadline exists. A 60-second exceedance was not run or claimed.
defects.reproduce: Create owned FIFO without writer and run committed verifier under a bounded subprocess timeout, as in run-independent.py.

known_gaps: Full 2024 required PHB/DMG/MM source bytes, precise revisions and applicable errata are unacquired/unresolved.
Full catalog denominator, production RightsGrant and RuntimeRulesetId remain unresolved; SRD subset integrity is not a full G07 gate.
FIFO probe was bounded externally at 2 seconds; no 60-second runtime exceedance claimed.
Additional exploratory unknown-field and section-continuation-page cases are retained in results but not treated as separate contract defects.
verdict_reason: Exact criterion 3 fails current independent behavioral probes; criteria 1, 2 and 4 pass. No acceptance criterion was weakened to treat omitted metadata as actual missing-source refusal.
